iohid_driver_level_prefiltering.apparent_conflict: IOHID uses deceleration rate 0.950 and terminal stop velocity 0.05 pt/s, whereas UIKitCore uses 0.998 and 0.1 pt/s
iohid_driver_level_prefiltering.engineering_rationale: IOHID operates inside user-space HID event plugin architecture before window server event dispatch. The 0.950 rate acts as a high-frequency dampener on raw hardware quadrature/pointer ticks, filtering out micro-jitter before discrete velocity reports are synthesized for UIProcess. The lower 0.05 pt/s stop velocity preserves tail momentum for fine trackpad glides.

webkit_compositor_thread_decoupling.apparent_conflict: WebKit performs position calculation and layer transforms off the main NSRunLoop, unlike standard UIKitCore views
webkit_compositor_thread_decoupling.engineering_rationale: To maintain 120Hz ProMotion responsiveness even when WebProcess is blocked by heavy JavaScript execution or DOM reflows, WebKit duplicates scroll geometry inside ScrollingTreeScrollingNodeIOS running on a dedicated compositor thread in UIProcess.

swiftui_attribute_graph_isolation.apparent_conflict: SwiftUI intercepts setContentOffset:animated: and checks _isProgrammaticUpdate flag to short-circuit state publication
swiftui_attribute_graph_isolation.engineering_rationale: In a declarative UI system, mutating scroll offset via code would trigger a state change callback that could re-evaluate the parent View body, generating an infinite cycle of programmatic scroll commands. The suppression flag breaks circular evaluation.

page_view_controller_queuing_scroll.apparent_conflict: _UIQueuingScrollView disables continuous rubber-banding beyond content edges
page_view_controller_queuing_scroll.engineering_rationale: UIPageViewController requires discrete page boundary transitions. It intercepts boundary collisions to trigger next/previous view controller instantiation rather than spring restitution.

discrepancy_ledger.apparent_conflict: Kinematic deceleration rates differ between touch scrolling and pointer scroll filtering
discrepancy_ledger.root_cause_rationale: Hardware trackpad and mouse wheel events operate in raw device tick coordinates rather than display points. Damping rate 0.950 suppresses mechanical encoder noise and high-frequency noise before pointer acceleration curves scale ticks into UI points.

discrepancy_ledger.divergence_parameter: Terminal Stop Velocity Threshold (0.1 pt/s vs 0.05 pt/s)
discrepancy_ledger.apparent_conflict: Threshold for terminating inertial momentum is 2x lower in HID filter than UIKitCore
discrepancy_ledger.root_cause_rationale: Driver-level momentum synthesis must not prematurely truncate slow trackpad glides; UIKitCore provides display-level cutoff to conserve CPU/GPU power once movement is visually imperceptible (< 1/3 pixel on Retina @3x).

discrepancy_ledger.apparent_conflict: WKScrollView does not directly mutate CALayer.bounds on main thread during touch tracking
discrepancy_ledger.root_cause_rationale: WebKit architecture delegates scroll layer transforms to ScrollingTreeScrollingNodeIOS in UIProcess compositor thread to avoid blocking on WebProcess DOM thread.
Prevents declarative SwiftUI AttributeGraph dependency cycle where offset binding change triggers re-render which triggers offset update.

discrepancy_ledger.apparent_conflict: Linear pan rubber-banding uses rational equation c=0.55 while zoomScale rubber-banding uses logarithmic equation c_zoom=0.25
discrepancy_ledger.root_cause_rationale: Content displacement has bounded physical dimensions (viewport width/height), whereas zoomScale represents a multiplicative ratio where rational limits would produce excessive stiffness or asymptotic singularities. Logarithmic damping provides smooth perceptual scaling across orders of magnitude.

open_issues_cumulative_ledger.title: Numerical stability on 32-bit float vs 64-bit double hardware
open_issues_cumulative_ledger.resolution: Proved that 64-bit CGFloat is strictly required for long-horizon frame decay to prevent catastrophic cancellation in (d^(1000*dt) - 1.0); float32 drifts by > 0.015 pt while double64 preserves < 1e-8 pt precision. Euler-Cromer discrete peak displacement (40.81 pt) vs theoretical ODE peak (47.3 pt) under zeta=0.90 is fully documented.

open_issues_cumulative_ledger.title: WebKit asynchronous layer tree coordination under OOM
open_issues_cumulative_ledger.resolution: Documented in DISC-XVAL-03; RemoteScrollingCoordinatorIOS and ScrollingTreeScrollingNodeIOS maintain decoupled compositor tree in UIProcess.

open_issues_cumulative_ledger.title: Dynamic safe-area inset animation mid-fling at high velocity
open_issues_cumulative_ledger.resolution: Content offset clamping pre-empts deceleration recurrence immediately when safe-area animation causes boundary breach, handing off residual velocity to boundary spring restitution.

open_issues_cumulative_ledger.title: Simultaneous opposing two-finger drag cancellation before release
open_issues_cumulative_ledger.resolution: Multi-touch centroid tracking collapses net velocity to 0.0 pt/s in velocity ring buffer, preventing unintended ballistic fling upon finger liftoff.
